_doc: Front-view mountain sprites for the crowd-built ranges of the adventure map (bead xaj.30, docs/art/classes/mountains.md). generate-image-v2 at native display size, never downscaled or mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-peak, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one rounded green mountain, each image a different one of these: a round grassy mountain with a bare grey rock crest, a broad shouldered green mountain with two rocky knobs, a green dome with a stony cap and a rocky scar on its face, a steep grassy peak with a grey rock tip. Grass slopes deep green #3f7d45, shadow #2a5a38, lit #69a659 on the left; rock warm grey #8d8a7c, shadow #5c5a54. Nearly the full image wide and about three quarters of the image tall.

Subject: one steep karst rock tower of a tropical jungle, each image a different one of these: a sheer rounded limestone tower with a bushy green top, a tall thumb of pale rock draped with hanging vines, a pair of joined limestone pillars with moss on their heads, a leaning rock stack covered in creepers. Pale limestone #a8a48c, shadow #6e6e5c; vines and moss #3f8a4e, shadow #24603f. Taller than wide: about half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

Subject: one jagged dry rock mountain, each image a different one of these: a sharp tan peak with a broken ridge, a craggy brown mountain with two points, a wide angular mountain of big rock facets, a steep pointed crag with a chipped shoulder. Rock tan #b8965e, shadow #7c5f3a, lit #d9bd82 on the left faces. Nearly the full image wide and about three quarters of the image tall.

Subject: one red desert rock formation, each image a different one of these: a flat-topped butte with level stripes of rock strata, a wide stepped mesa with two ledges, a cluster of three tall hoodoo rock columns, a narrow flat-topped rock stack with a sloping skirt of scree. Rock red-orange #c46a3c, shadow #823f28, lit #e39a5c, pale strata stripes #e8c07a. Flat tops, level bands. Nearly the full image wide and about three quarters of the image tall.
